Dialogs.Dialog: Maybe it's time I forgave you？
Today's my birthday. Stay with me, okay？
Thank you for coming on my birthday.
What kind of person forgets his girlfriend's birthday？
Happy birthday, thank you for being born... I love you.
Happy birthday. Let's be together today too. ...I love you.
Happy birthday！ Today's the day the most important person was born... Lo-ve you▼
Happy birthday. I wanted to say it on the day...
Happy birthday. It's a little late, but...
Happy birthday！ Next year, I hope I can say it on the day.
Today's the anniversary of the day we first met. Our special day.
Today is our anniversary... The first day I met you. Let's stay together forever.
What day is today？ ...The correct answer is the day we met. It's our anniversary.
Today's the day we started going out. ...I love you. More than back then.
Today's the anniversary of when we started going out. ...I love you. Now and always.
Today's the day we started going out. Did you remember？ Hehe, lo-ve you▼
Today's the day we first kissed... Let's always remember it, okay？ *smooch*
Today... is the anniversary of your first kiss. So... *smooch*
What anniversary is today？ The answer is... come closer？ ...*smooch*
Here's Monday. Let's do our best this week too！ Right？
It's Tuesday. The week's still lo-ong, you know？ Hang in there！
Wednesday. Halfway through the week, cheer up！
Thursday. What should we do this weekend？
It's Friday. A little exciting, isn't it？
It's Saturday！ Hey, what should we do？
Sunday at last. Want to go out today？
On Sundays I want to just laze around together... Okay？
The breeze is getting nicer and nicer.
Don't you want to take a walk when the weather is nice？
It's summer... Let's make lots of memories this year too, okay？
Hot every day, huh... Take care of yourself, okay？
Autumn... I'm feeling a little bit sentimental.
Autumn... The season of delicious sweet potatoes... Hehe.
It's cold every day, isn't it？ ...Don't catch a cold now, okay？
No curling up under the kotatsu. Let's go out together？
Happy New Year. Let's be together this year too？
I had my first dream of the year... What it was is a secret. Hehe.
My first dream of the year was of you, of course... How embarrassing.
Did you have your first dream of the year？ Was it... about me？ Just kidding.
New term starts today. Let's do our best together！
I wonder if I can make good seven-herb porridge this year.
Today's Coming-of-Age Day... I want us to come of age together too.
Today's Kagami-biraki. Don't eat too much mochi, okay？
Today's Setsubun. I got some beans ready... Can I throw them at you？
First day of spring. It's spring on the calendar, but real spring is still far off, huh.
Today's National Foundation Day. Do you know where it comes from？
What day is it today？ ...Hehe, hey, come quick！
Today's a special day, so you're mine. Hehe！
February 14th... What day is it？ Just kidding, hehe！
Doesn't a leap year make you feel like you got an extra day？
Plum blossom season is almost here. Spring's coming again soon...
Today's the girls' festival. No boys allowed. Hehe, just kidding.
Today's March 14th... Hm？ That's all, you know？ Hehe！
Today I'm keeping you all to myself. Because it's March 14th.
Today's March 14th... so stay with me, okay？
On the spring equinox, day and night are the same length. Want to measure？ Just kidding.
Spring break's coming up. Let's make lots of new friends, okay？
Spring break starts today. There's not much homework, so let's take it easy together.
I've never told a lie. ...If I said that, would you believe me？
Manaka is actually a rabbit... It's true！
I hate you... Ahh, just kidding！ It's a lie！ Sorry！
New term starts today. We get to see each other at school every day again, right？
I love cherry blossoms. Let's go see them together, okay？
Today's Showa Day. Emperor Showa's birthday.
Golden Week's coming up. Hey, where should we go？
Today's Constitution Day. I want to be together over the holidays, don't you？
Today's Greenery Day. Let's go to the park with all the fresh green？
Today's Children's Day. Hey, are we still kids？
First day of summer. On the calendar, it's summer from today.
Did you get a Mother's Day present？ Don't forget to say thank you when you give it.
It's the sports festival. All right, we're gonna win！ Just kidding.
Today's the longest day of the year. Summer's getting close.
Time to switch to summer uniforms. Once the rainy season's over, it's summer.
Father's Day is a little embarrassing, huh. But I think he'll be happy if you give him a present.
Beach season opens today, but is the water still cold？
It's Tanabata. I want us to write the same wish on our strips...
Summer break's almost here. Once tests are over, right？
It's Marine Day. Want to go out？
Summer break starts today！ Let's make lo-ots of memories, okay？
Today's the first day of autumn. Even though it's still the height of summer outside.
I love fireworks... Let's watch them together.
Obon starts today. Our ancestors come back, you know？ ...A little scary, huh？
Summer break's ending... But we'll see each other at school again, right？
It's the equinox week. Maybe I'll make ohagi.
Respect for the Aged Day. I used to give my grandparents shoulder-rub coupons. Brings back memories.
Autumn equinox. Have you noticed the sky's gotten higher lately？
Time to say goodbye to summer clothes. See you again next year.
The harvest moon is coming soon. I hope the sky is clear so we can see a beautiful moon？
Today's Halloween. Maybe I'll play a trick？ Hehe！
Today's Culture Day. What is culture... I got to thinking about that.
Mornings and evenings are getting so cold. Will this winter be cold？
Shichi-Go-San brings back memories. We still have my photo up at home.
Labor Thanksgiving Day. What kind of jobs will we have in the future？
It's the culture festival. Hehe, festivals are so exciting.
Time flies... It's already winter break.
It's the winter solstice. Maybe I'll make simmered pumpkin.
Today's the Emperor's Birthday, but for us it's Christmas Eve Eve.
Winter break, huh... This year's almost over.
Merry Christmas. I want to thank God for meeting you.
Merry Christmas. May happiness come to you next year too...
Merry Christmas. I hope we can spend it together...
It's already New Year's Eve... Thank you for everything this year.
Test time. Don't rush, go at your own pace, okay？
Long time no see. ...Geez, I was lonely.
I was so-o lonely, you know.
Ah... You finally came. Hehe, hurry！
Thank goodness... I thought you forgot about me. Hey, come quick？
Geez, leaving me all alone... Hehe, come quick？
I'm happy to see you, but... don't overdo it, okay？
You came again... I'm happy, but please take a break, okay？
You wanted to see me that much？ Hehe, okay？
Did you come to see me？
Hey... Today, could it be you're here for me？
You know, I... about you... No.
Hey, hey, what should we do today？ Hehe！
Ah... I was just thinking I wanted to see you. Hehe.
When I can't see you, all I think about is you.
I want you to know more about me...
I want you to teach me a lot of things I don't know.
I was just thinking I wanted to see you... Hehe, telepathy？
Lately, I've been thinking a lot about you...
I want to know more about you...
Even seeing you every day isn't nearly enough.
Where are you going to take me today？
You're late. Geez... Come on, hurry？
I was thinking I wanted to see you too.
Let's make more memories together today, okay？
Finally I get to see you. I'm not letting you go home... Just kidding.
I'll teach you all kinds of things you don't know... Just kidding.
When we're together, today will be special too, right？
